title: Record changed
description: A data file under the data folder changed: rewritten by a write through the command layer, by the Owner or an Agent, or changed by a merge or a checkout, which the server announces as `spec:changed`.

title: Schema changed
description: A product's declaration of its own kinds and relations changed, through the command layer, or Lathe's migrations changed. The MCP server announces its tools again.

title: Use case changed
description: A use case, or a record in it, was added, changed, moved or removed by one of the Use case aggregate's commands; the write's answer lists it with the rows that changed.

title: Check changed
description: A check row was added, changed or removed, among Lathe's checks or a product's own, through the command layer, which rewrites its `check.jsonl`; the server announces it as `spec:changed`.

title: Page opened
description: The reader went to an address in the app, by a link, a command, the address bar or the back button, which opens its page on the stage it names.

title: Active tab changed
description: The active tab of a space changed: activated, cycled, a new tab opened in front, or a neighbor after a close.

title: Theme chosen
description: The reader kept a theme from the Color theme command or the Appearance page, which applies at once and is kept for them.

title: Color mode chosen
description: The reader chose Light, Dark or System, which decides which of every theme's two color sets shows.

title: Theme made
description: The reader made a theme of their own, by duplicating a theme or importing a theme file, which they can then edit.

title: Product window opened
description: The reader opened a product folder, from the Open dialog, Open Recent, the Dock or at launch, and it opened in a window of its own.

title: Product window closed
description: A product window closed, by the reader or because the shell quit, with its size and place saved for the next time.
